grants.description: Verify your identity using passport, visa records and biometric residence permit
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and current immigration status before processing your ILR application

grants.description: Access your complete UK immigration history including all visas, entry/exit records, and any previous applications
grants.purpose: To verify you have met the continuous residence and qualifying period requirements

grants.description: Check your UK criminal record and overseas criminal history declarations
grants.purpose: To assess whether you meet the good character requirement for settlement

grants.description: Share your tax and employment records to verify income and lawful work
grants.purpose: To verify you meet income requirements (if applicable) and have been working lawfully in the UK

grants.description: Provide fingerprints and facial photograph at a biometric appointment
grants.purpose: For identity verification and production of biometric residence permit if ILR is granted

grants.description: Verify your residential addresses in the UK for the qualifying period
grants.purpose: To confirm continuous residence in the UK and assist with identity verification

grants.description: Verify relationships with UK-settled family members (if applying through family route)
grants.purpose: To confirm eligibility for family-based ILR applications

revocation.mechanism: Contact Home Office or revoke through UKVI online account before decision is made
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled and fees will not be refunded if consent is revoked after submission. Biometric data may be retained for immigration enforcement purposes.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot submit biometric data on your behalf - you must attend appointment in person. Agent cannot make payment without your explicit authorization. Agent cannot answer good character questions about criminal history or immigration breaches on your behalf - you must declare these yourself. Agent cannot sign the application declaration - you must review and sign personally.
